description: Submit media work for the authenticated account. Returns an asynchronous request ID. For a sequence of work, prefer batch_submit and hand off the dashboard URL without polling. Use library IDs from assets_list where supported. Rights/privacy acknowledgements must reflect the user’s authorization; never invent consent. Limits remain active through result email delivery.

inputSchema.description: Analyze one permitted public HTTPS YouTube/Shorts/Live/TikTok video URL. Playlists, credentials, IP hosts, custom ports and other websites are unsupported.

acknowledge_privacy.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

acknowledge_rights.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended operation. Reuse on network retries.

source_url.description: Single YouTube/Shorts/Live/TikTok video HTTPS URL,10–2048 characters. No playlists, credentials or non-443 ports. The backend validates allowed hosts and paths.

title.description: Optional request title, up to200 characters.

name: media_create
title: Analyze public video
